name: Student Document Management API Examples
description: Ready-to-use API examples for student document management system

api_endpoints.name: 4. Upload New Document
api_endpoints.curl_example:
curl -X POST http://your-domain.com/api/documents \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN' \
  -F 'document_name=Birth Certificate' \
  -F 'notes=Original copy' \
  -F 'file=@/path/to/file.pdf'

api_endpoints.name: 8. Download Document
api_endpoints.note: Browser will download the file with original filename
